sources.title: VoiceNet: Fine-Grained Voice Understanding Beyond Emotion at Scale
sources.snippet: Ten of the eleven models (all except LCO-EMBEDDING-OMNI-3B) are evaluated against four established speech-emotion datasets to test transfer beyond VOICENET. EmoNet-Voice (Schuhmann et al., 2025a) provides 12,600 synthetic clips across 40 fine-grained emotion classes (the synthetic v1 release that motivates VOICENET's 40-emotion taxonomy).

sources.title: VoiceNet: Fine-Grained Voice Understanding Beyond Emotion at Scale | AI ...
sources.snippet: On synthetic EmoNet-Voice, the zero-shot LCO-Embedding-Omni-7B leads at 0.167 while VoiceCLAP-Large reaches 0.155. General-audio CLAPs remain near chance on its 40 emotion classes. The external-dataset results connect VoiceNet to broader work on speech emotion recognition, while showing that performance depends on the dataset and label set.

sources.title: LCO-Embedding-Omni-3B-2605-GGUF - Hugging Face
sources.snippet: LCO-Embedding-Omni-3B is a multimodal embedding model based on the Thinker component of Qwen 2.5 Omni, fine-tuned with LoRA and contrastive learning to produce 2048-dimensional embeddings from text, images, audio, and video.

sources.title: GitHub - LAION-AI/voicenet: VoiceNet — perceptual voice & speech ...
sources.snippet: → https://projects.laion.ai/voicenet/ An interactive showcase of VoiceNet predictions on 100 diverse, multilingual Emolia speech clips. Each sample has an audio player, a radar profile of all 57 regression dimensions, the genuineness and vocal‑burst‑blend gauges, and a full per‑dimension table comparing the regression and classification predictions.

sources.title: LCO-Embedding-Omni-7B - Hugging Face
sources.snippet: Evaluation Results We evaluate LCO-Embedding with state-of-the-art embedding models, including E5-V, Voyage Multimodal 3, mmE5, and GME, on a MIEB-Lite benchmark (51 tasks) broken down by task categories. Performance and efficiency comparisons of different training strategies using 3B and 7B variants of Qwen2.5-VL backbones.
